title: Logovi i telemetrija na Linuxu
summary: Linux logovi (auth.log, journald, auditd), vrijeme i integritet logova, cloud i Kubernetes izvori te prikupljanje i normalizacija u ECS i OCSF.
summary_en: Linux logs (auth.log, journald, auditd), log time and integrity, cloud and Kubernetes sources, and collection and normalization into ECS and OCSF.
